name: gpu-voxels
description: GPU-Voxels: volumetric collision detection on the GPU (CUDA backend; Vulkan backend in preparation)

cuda.description: CUDA backend (GVL_BACKEND_CUDA); needs the CUDA toolkit installed

pcl.description: PCL point cloud support (.pcd reader) in gpu_voxels_helpers (GVL_WITH_PCL)

vulkan.description: Vulkan backend headers and allocator (GVL_BACKEND_VULKAN). The Vulkan SDK (VULKAN_SDK: loader, validation layer, glslang) is a separate prerequisite.

cuda-tests.description: Boost.Test and CppUnit for the vendored icl_core test suites (BUILD_TESTS with GVL_BACKEND_CUDA; icl_core is only built with the CUDA backend)

viewer.description: Legacy OpenGL viewer and its Boost.Interprocess provider interface (packages/gpu_visualization, vis_interface) - currently not part of the CMake build

vulkan-viewer.description: Window of the in-process Vulkan viewer (GVL_VULKAN_VIEWER): GLFW. No separate viewer process and no Boost.Interprocess.
